description.en: Open-source Chatterbox family for expressive TTS and voice conversion, with emotion exaggeration control, fast generation, zero-shot voice cloning, and an integrated multilingual TTS path.
description.zh: 开源 Chatterbox 家族，用于富有表现力的 TTS 与音色转换，具备情绪夸张控制、快速生成、零样本音色克隆与集成的多语言 TTS 路径。

exaggeration.en: Emotion exaggeration. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
exaggeration.zh: 情绪夸张强度。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

guidance_scale.en: T3 classifier-free guidance scale. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
guidance_scale.zh: T3 无分类器引导强度。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

temperature.en: T3 sampling temperature. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
temperature.zh: T3 采样温度。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

repetition_penalty.en: T3 repetition penalty. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
repetition_penalty.zh: T3 重复惩罚。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

min_p.en: Minimum sampling probability. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
min_p.zh: 最小采样概率。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

top_p.en: Nucleus sampling probability. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
top_p.zh: 核采样概率。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

flow_guidance_scale.en: S3Gen flow guidance scale. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
flow_guidance_scale.zh: S3Gen flow 引导强度。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

max_tokens.en: Maximum generated speech tokens. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
max_tokens.zh: 生成语音 token 上限。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

do_sample.en: Enable sampling. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
do_sample.zh: 启用采样。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

stop_on_eos.en: Stop token generation on EOS. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
stop_on_eos.zh: 遇到 EOS 时停止生成 token。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

num_inference_steps.en: Voice conversion flow steps; max_steps is also accepted.
num_inference_steps.zh: 音色转换 flow 步数；也接受 max_steps。

seed.en: Sampling seed; omitted chooses a random seed. Captured during clone preparation; changing it on the same prepared session is rejected.
seed.zh: 采样随机种子；省略时随机选择。在克隆准备阶段捕获；同一已准备会话中修改会被拒绝。

source_audio.en: Voice conversion source WAV path; overrides audio_input.
source_audio.zh: 音色转换源 WAV 路径；覆盖 audio_input。

target_voice.en: Voice conversion target WAV path; overrides the speaker reference.
target_voice.zh: 音色转换目标 WAV 路径；覆盖说话人参考。
